resources.string: This policy describes Visual Routines version 0.1.0 and how the app works now.

Visual Routines stores the routines you create, including routine names, steps, notes, order, selected image references, app-private copies of images you select, and image descriptions. It also stores active routine progress and local display settings. Routine text and selected images may contain personal information if you choose to enter it. Selected images are copied for offline use without changing the original files. Source metadata is not kept in the normalized copies. Temporary import and recovery files may be created while editing or saving.

The app does not transmit your routine data, image copies, progress, or settings to the Visual Routines project, advertisers, analytics providers, or another developer-operated service. The current app has no app account, backend, analytics, advertising, tracking, or Internet permission, and it integrates no third-party data-collection service.

Cloud backup is disabled. On supported Android versions, Android\'s device migration can transfer routines, stored image copies, active progress, and settings to another device during migration. Android or the device migration service handles that transfer; the app does not send the data to the Visual Routines project.

A routine remains on the device until you delete it in the app, clear the app\'s storage, or uninstall the app. Active progress remains until you complete or reset it, replace it after confirmation, clear app storage, or uninstall. Unused image copies are removed after successful changes or abandoned editing. Copies needed by a saved routine or a restorable draft are retained. Clearing app storage or uninstalling also removes these copies. Original images outside the app are unaffected. Settings remain until you change them, clear app storage, or uninstall. Data already transferred to another device must be removed separately on that device.

Android\'s app sandbox protects the app-private files from ordinary access by other apps. Visual Routines does not add its own encryption, so do not use routine text as a secure vault for confidential information.

This policy covers the current local-only app. If a future release adds accounts, synchronization, remote routine management, or other network or data processing, its maintainer must update this policy and the relevant user disclosures before enabling or releasing that feature. This policy does not describe or authorize features that are absent from the current version.

Project information and source code are available at https://github.com/oikumene-works/visual-routines. Do not include routine content, images, or other personal information in a public report. The project does not currently offer a private support inbox.
